order: One pass S01–S10: local rules, one extraction, one rules-set Decisions, one extraction-set Decisions; concurrency one. Whole paired group shares exact retained records/context, including both S05 posts and both S10 posts. No silent per-post fallback increasing call count.

reuse.scope: Accepted saved paid pilot outputs only; Lindgren family excluded and does not match any selected group.
reuse.rule: Reuse requires exact complete input/context, prompt/schema, producer version/model settings, proposal bytes and postprocessing policy; Decisions also requires exact question and proposal set. Mark reused artifacts and old usage; never count original fee or latency twice.

budget.enforcement_required: Reuse the persistent aggregate and transactionally reserve the next entire call ceiling against all settled ceilings plus every pending/unknown reservation. No state reset, no clearing the original unknown/block, no new independent $0.52 ledger. A reviewed scope-specific continuation is required. Record sent before HTTP; retain uncertain reservation and stop on uncertain outcome, TLS/HTTP/schema/refusal/truncation/missing usage/bound error. Settle only complete safely priced usage; no retries.
budget.limitation: Current full-context Responses reservation leaves only $0.004883722 of additional settled-charge margin before a later extraction refuses. Tight verified per-Responses input bounds are required for a credible ten-group completion at this cap. Decisions can retain its accepted whole-context bound, but a late stage may still refuse if prior charges exceed its margin. Do not replace a proved ceiling with estimated token counts.

pricing.ordinary_billing_assumptions: Existing accepted direct standard-tier/no-tools pricing assumptions only; account-specific premium/fee changes invalidate this budget.

offline_preflight_blockers: Freeze and verify a source-only multi-record input/projection and deterministic matched-field scorer for corrections, PP replacement and team-only claims. Current single-source pilot cannot be reused unchanged for all ten groups.

Freeze the same available identity/context inputs for rules and Luna without leaking benchmark labels. Existing rules requires player context; no new authentic roster/schedule context is acquired by this task. Missing identity/slot/game fields must remain held and denominators retained.

Prove tighter complete-input Responses reservations for exact sealed requests, or accept an explicitly partial pass; full-model maxima do not guarantee ten groups within the existing cap. No token counter request authorized here.

Review a scope-specific continuation of the aggregate ledger without clearing original unknown state; freeze exact requests, prompts, schemas, source/consumer pins, no-network controls and all call limits before any proposed execution.
non_offline_gate: Owner authorization of the exact source payloads/destination, bounded request set and aggregate budget is still required. This plan requests no execution.
limitations: Ten purposively selected previously exposed development families, not independent random samples or future holdout.
Owner labels plus assistant source supplements do not authenticate identities, medical truth, full threads/media or actual game applicability.
Same Luna extracting/verifying is not independent corroboration. Whole-set support scores are uncalibrated and do not certify each field or repair omissions.
No production eligibility, delivery guarantee or calibrated accuracy conclusion; no prompt tuning against answers during the scored run.
